sources.title: Qwen3.7: The Agent Frontier
sources.evidence: Reopened for the October 27 parameter re-audit through the search-indexed official May 20 launch; direct extraction still returned an empty page. It identifies Qwen3.7-Max as proprietary and describes agent training and evaluations, but publishes neither total nor active parameters. Building on the environment-scaling approach introduced in Qwen3.5 describes a training method, not a named base-model or checkpoint relationship. The Extend Attention architecture discussion concerns a kernel the model optimized, not its own internal architecture.

sources.title: qwen3.7-max Model Info
sources.evidence: Reopened and inspected the full current exact-model specification on October 27. The alias remains functionally equivalent to qwen3.7-max-2026-05-20; the separate June 8 snapshot adds image/video understanding. Capabilities, context, output, thinking limits and rate tables contain no total or activated parameter count, named base-model lineage, or dense/MoE specification.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: Exact qwen3.7-max alias and May 20 snapshot have explicit May 20, 2026 release rows in Global scope under US (Virginia), Hong Kong (China), and Germany (Frankfurt). China (Beijing), Singapore International, and Japan Global list May 21. The May 17 snapshot belongs to the separate preview entry. Regional headings and matching rows were inspected in the full HTML.

sources.title: Qwen3.7: The Agent Frontier — official README
sources.evidence: Reopened the full raw official README on October 27. Its benchmark table contains task scores only; there are no total or active parameter specifications. The Qwen3.5 reference is to environment-scaling methodology, not a named predecessor checkpoint from which size can be inherited.

sources.title: Alibaba Unveils New AI Chip, Flagship Model, and Rebuilt Cloud Stack AI for Agentic Era
sources.evidence: May 20, 2026 corporate announcement identifies Qwen3.7-Max as Alibaba's new language model for sustained agent tasks.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-Max: A New Bar for Coding and Cowork
sources.evidence: The August 3 successor launch was inspected through the search-indexed article, including its full benchmark tables. It publishes 2.4T total and 95B active for Qwen3.8-Max only. Qwen3.7-Max appears as the previous flagship and a benchmark comparator, without a total/active parameter row or explicit same-size named-base relationship. These successor specifications cannot establish Qwen3.7-Max size.

sources.title: MaxCompute: AI inference fees
sources.evidence: Reopened the October 10 documentation and its supported-model comparison. The Qwen3.8-Max row explicitly specifies a 2.4T MoE model; the distinct Qwen3.7-Max row describes a text-only flagship without a parameter count or architecture. This later first-party comparison does not disclose Qwen3.7-Max total or active size.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 and Qwen3.7 model selection comparison
sources.publisher: Alibaba Cloud Developer Community user contribution
sources.evidence: September 8 user-contributed comparison claims approximately 1.2T total and 45B active for Qwen3.7-Max. The page explicitly states it is contributed by a registered community user and that the contributor owns the content; hosting on aliyun.com is not developer authorship. No supporting exact-model primary disclosure was found. Used only as a lead, not a verified specification.

sources.title: Qwen3.7 Max and Plus comparison
sources.publisher: Alibaba Cloud Developer Community user contribution
sources.evidence: August 3 community article by 问号云 carries the same user-contribution disclaimer. It claims 1.2T total while giving 45B active in prose and 450B active in its table, and calls the model dense. These internally inconsistent, unattributed figures are not a Qwen developer specification and supply no supported count or architecture.

name.note: Normalized display spelling of the official Qwen3.7-Max name.

developer.note: Alibaba's corporate announcement explicitly identifies the model as its own.

family.note: Official documentation places this exact model in the Qwen3.7 series.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit exact-alias release is May 20 in Global scope in Virginia, Hong Kong and Frankfurt. May 21 is the China/Singapore rollout; May 17 is a different preview snapshot.

open_weights.note: The exact-model launch explicitly calls it proprietary.

license.note: Proprietary hosted model; no downloadable-weight license is supplied. API service terms are not an open-weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh launch, specification, README and later first-party comparison checks disclose no total count or explicit named-base lineage supporting a nominal inference. Qwen3.5 training-method references and Qwen3.8 successor counts do not establish this model size; community figures remain unsupported.

active_parameters_b.note: No active count is supplied in the original documents or later first-party comparisons. The 95B figure belongs to Qwen3.8-Max; community 45B/450B claims have no supporting primary disclosure. No total-to-active equality is inferred.

architecture.note: Reviewed primary documents do not specify dense/MoE or attention architecture. Agent training and kernel-optimization descriptions do not establish the model's internal architecture.

context_window.note: Explicit context-window limit in tokens, distinct from the smaller maximum input allowance.

modalities.note: Exact alias remains text-only. Vision belongs to the separately named June 8 snapshot.

reasoning.note: The alias specification includes thinking-mode and chain-of-thought limits.

tool_call.note: Function Calling is explicitly supported for the exact alias.

description.value: Text-only Qwen3.7 model for coding and agent tasks, with a one-million-token context window, thinking mode, and function calling.
description.note: Neutral description of documented capabilities; omits developer positioning as frontier.

patch.notes: Qwen3.7-Max is proprietary; total/active parameter counts and internal architecture remain undisclosed. No named-base relationship establishes a nominal size, and Qwen3.8-Max specifications apply to the successor. The qwen3.7-max alias is equivalent to the text-only May 20 snapshot; the separate June 8 snapshot adds vision. Earliest explicit regional release is May 20, 2026 in Global scope in Virginia, Hong Kong and Frankfurt; China and Singapore list May 21.

patch.description: Text-only Qwen3.7 model for coding and agent tasks, with a one-million-token context window, thinking mode, and function calling.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains explicit null total and active counts after reopening the original launch, exact specification and official README and checking later Qwen3.8 and Alibaba comparisons. No published nominal size or explicit named-base lineage was found. Community 1.2T and conflicting 45B/450B claims are user contributions without primary support. Preserve the original May 20 release and text-only alias findings and undisclosed architecture.
